name: Scrolling Popups
description: Popups get scrollbars when their text does not fit: a popup is never taller or wider than the screen (its buttons stay at its bottom, where they always are), and when its text is taller than the room left, or wider than the box (a long line, or one very long word), a vertical and/or a horizontal scrollbar appears, drawn with the game's own scrollbar pictures. A New Home and The Lost Children have no up/down scrollbar pictures of their own, so they borrow The Secret City's (shipped as new picture files; no game file is replaced). Scroll with the mouse wheel over the popup, the arrows, by dragging the knob or by clicking the bar; the text starts at the top and starts over when it changes. A popup whose text fits looks and works exactly as before. This covers the island-event popups (plain, two-choice and visitor events, and Custom Island Events from Story / Cheat Upgrades; also when the result replaces the question in a popup sized for the question), message boxes (tech and puzzle results, confirmations), tips (the tutorial and notices), the tombstone (a long name or cause of death scrolls sideways) and Statistics and Create Nickname (a long translation or name scrolls sideways). The Options panel (each label sits beside its slider or button, which cannot scroll with it), the few-second online-statistics notice, and the panels with no text body (Change Player, the outfit chooser) are as the game draws them. There is no keyboard scrolling. Nothing is saved, so the patch can be ticked or unticked at any time. **Needs no other patch.** Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it. **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.** The companion is "VVFP Scrolling Popups.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; if it cannot be loaded, the popups are as the game draws them.
behavior_changes: The message box (vtable 0x476DC4, laid out by 0x432C90): its `call 0x40D140` sizing the panel (0x432EE8) calls the companion, which keeps the size asked for and caps the width and the height to the screen's (800 x 600, read from the drawing context) less 16 px on each side; the game then centres the panel and places its text and buttons as always.

The text control draw's `call 0x4096A0` drawing a control's text (0x40CB77) calls the companion: the text of a message box whose panel was capped (the control's parent has the message box's vtable and asked for more than the screen holds) is drawn under a clip rectangle set to the room the box keeps for it (0x14 below the panel's top, 0x1E from its sides, above its buttons), moved by the scroll position, with the scrollbars beside it; every other text, and a message box's text that fits, is the stock call unchanged.

The tip (vtable 0x48FAC8): its `call 0x40D140` sizing the panel (0x443D86) is capped the same way. The frame draw's tail (0x40D383, `mov edx, [esi]` to the `jmp` into the dialog's body draw) jumps to the companion, which makes the same pops and calls the body draw: a tip that asked for more than the screen holds has its body drawn with its panel rectangle (+0x14..+0x20, which the body draw places everything by) moved by the scroll position and by what the capped panel moved its centred contents, under a clip set to the box (0x24 from the sides, 0x0A below the top, above twice the OK button's height), the rectangle put back after, with the scrollbars; every other dialog's body is called exactly as before. The island-event dialog (plain, vtable 0x476DF8): its `call 0x40D140` (0x434A6B) is capped the same way, and the room it asks for below its text is kept. The island-event dialog (two choices, vtable 0x476714): its `call 0x40D140` (0x42255F) is capped the same way, and the room it asks for below its text is kept. The island-event dialog (sacks and vials / two choices, vtable 0x476F30): its `call 0x40D140` (0x439FA4) is capped the same way, and the room it asks for below its text is kept. Through the frame draw's tail, an island-event dialog whose text shown now (measured with the game's own text height and width; the result when it has replaced the question) does not fit above that room, or is wider than the panel, has its body drawn with the y its constructor keeps (+0x64 / +0x6C) and, for a wide text, the panel's sides moved by the scroll position, under a clip, with the scrollbars.

The tombstone (vtable 0x48FB48, a fixed panel): its body draw draws every line with the centred-block draw, whose call of the core draw (0x4096F1) calls the companion. Through the frame draw's tail the body is drawn once measuring (each line's extent recorded, nothing drawn, the clip empty), and when a line runs past the panel's sides (a long name, Cause of Death's cause line, a translation) the body is drawn with the panel rectangle (which the body draw and Cause of Death's line place everything by) moved by the scroll position, under a clip 16 px in from the sides and above the OK button, with a horizontal bar below the lines; otherwise exactly as before.

The same for Statistics (vtable 0x477640), Create Nickname (vtable 0x47647C): at the text control draw's call (0x40CB77) a line of one of these panels is measured with all the panel's lines (its window's text controls); when one runs past the panel's sides, every line is drawn moved by the scroll position under a clip 16 px in from the sides, above the controls in the panel's lower half (its buttons, a text box), with a horizontal bar below the lines; text boxes, buttons and every panel that fits are drawn exactly as before.

The event pump's `call 0x402070` handing a mouse event to the game (0x403EFE) calls the companion first: a press on a scrollbar of the popup drawn this moment, a knob drag and its release are used by the companion and not passed on; every other event goes to the game unchanged. The wheel is read by an SDL event watch (SDL_AddEventWatch, SDL_MOUSEWHEEL).

The scrollbars are the game's own pictures (WideSlider2.png and sliderhandle.png (its own) and Images\vvfp_scroll_up/down/track/knob.png (The Secret City's UpArrowButton, DownArrowButton, VerticalScrollTrack and VerticalScrollKnob, borrowed)): Up/DownArrowButton, VerticalScrollTrack fitted to the bar's height, VerticalScrollKnob; the horizontal bar is WideSlider2 fitted to the vertical track's width (18 px) with sliderhandle fitted to the knob's size turned sideways.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion writes its sites at run time, only after verifying their stock bytes and the instructions before them (all of them, or none).

A popup whose text fits is drawn by the very same call as in the stock game; the popups' text fields keep their sizes; keys, the buttons, the events and the save are unchanged. No game picture is replaced: the borrowed pictures are new files.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; the companion emulated on the published executable's own popup code with the game's own fonts and pictures (tests/test_scrolling_popups.py: the panel capped, the clip set and restored, wheel, arrows, knob drag and track clicks moving the drawn lines, the buttons at the panel's bottom, a fitting text drawn exactly as the stock game draws it); runtime/player confirmation pending
